# Report 9 tables (generated by results/exp9/report9.py)

Variants, all d=5, 5 rounds, p=0.003, data/d5_wide_x5, h48/l4, fp32, batch 512, 300000 steps, --compile, --stale-prob 0.3, single fingerprint. Baseline = the existing adaptive-stale models (seeds 0, 1, 2). N = the same command plus --aux-noise (noise-map head on the last feature map + log(scale) head on the pooled vector; loss = BCE + 0.1 MSE(p_hot x 10) + 0.1 MSE(log scale), auxiliary losses masked on stale steps; the logit path is unchanged). NF = N plus --film (fingerprint encoder 2 x Conv3d 16 ch, zero-initialised per-layer gamma/beta, h <- h (1 + gamma) + beta after each GELU). Ensemble members: N noise-map head: decoder_adaptive_d5_aux_long_s0.pt, decoder_adaptive_d5_aux_long_s1.pt, decoder_adaptive_d5_aux_long_s2.pt; NF noise-map head + FiLM: decoder_adaptive_d5_auxfilm_long_s0.pt, decoder_adaptive_d5_auxfilm_long_s1.pt, decoder_adaptive_d5_auxfilm_long_s2.pt. static-wide = the existing static models trained on data/d5_wide_x5. Baseline and static-wide results are reused from results/exp6. Ensemble = mean of the 3 seeds' logits > 0 (fixed). Live: each model's own causal buffer; frozen: every channel from the nominal test set's fingerprint shots. Update every 200 shots. Streams pooled over stream seeds 0,1,2,3,4. McNemar exact, two-sided; p in 0.001–0.05 = weak evidence; no multiple-testing correction. The best WindowDEM is picked per phase after the fact.

## Decision rule (fixed in advance, computed here)

A variant passes if its ensemble beats the adaptive-stale ensemble on bursts_big drift steps with p < 0.001, and is not worse than it on drift or later steps in any regime (bursts, bursts_big, hot_qubit, telegraph) at p < 0.001, and is not worse on the nominal test set at p < 0.001. Live ensembles, pooled streams.

| variant | verdict | win (bursts_big drift, p < 0.001) | losses (drift/later any regime, nominal test set; p < 0.001) |
|---|---|---|---|
| N noise-map head | **FAILS** | none | none |
| NF noise-map head + FiLM | **FAILS** | none | none |

## Noise-map quality (the diagnostic claim; live fingerprint, pooled over stream seeds)

Per step: predicted p_hot of each qubit = mean over the step's shots of the noise head / 10; predicted scale = exp(mean predicted log scale). top-k: fraction of truly hot qubits among the k highest predicted (k = number of hot qubits; steps with hot qubits only). MAE p_hot on hot qubits / non-hot qubits; MAE of the predicted scale; mean predicted p_hot over all qubits (on nominal and after steps = false-alarm level). bursts_big is held out (8 qubits, p_hot 0.1; training had 1-6 qubits, p_hot 0.005-0.08). Cells: seed mean ± std, then the seeds' values.
